name: Hornero Countdown
description: Bar timers: a countdown with 5/10/25 minute presets and a stopwatch behind one indicator, deadline and anchor based so sleep never loses time.
author: HorneroOS contributors

defaultMinutes.description: Countdown length in minutes used until a preset is chosen.

deadlineEpochMs.description: Saved running deadline in epoch milliseconds (0 when not running). Managed by the timer; do not edit.

totalSeconds.description: Saved countdown length in seconds (0 means the default length). Managed by the timer; do not edit.

remainingSeconds.description: Saved paused time remaining in seconds (0 means a full countdown). Managed by the timer; do not edit.

accumulatedMs.description: Saved elapsed milliseconds while paused. Managed by the stopwatch; do not edit.

startedEpochMs.description: Saved start anchor in epoch milliseconds (0 when paused). Managed by the stopwatch; do not edit.

showTenths.description: Show tenths of a second in the elapsed time.

changelog.notes: Gate sub-second stopwatch and flash timers on active/visible state.
Declare marketplace compatibility (minShellVersion); catalogue description no longer leads with an internal version.
Absorbs Stopwatch: the popover switches between countdown and stopwatch, the indicator follows whichever is running. Stopwatch stored state carries over.
PluginKit 3 on Hornero Signal: tokens, glyph and variant names ported; task progress via UiProgress.

Productivity Timers 2.0: compact indicator plus popover with presets and progress, deadline-correct timing persisted across sleep/reload, typed defaultMinutes setting (default 5), completion toast, Theme tokens and Argentine Spanish translation.
Bar countdown with 5/10/25 minute presets, start/pause/reset and a flashing DONE ring at zero.
